126: // linkRewriter builds a replacer that rewrites godoc links to point at the
127: // gopages base URL or the public pkg.go.dev site.
128: func linkRewriter(defaultPackagePrefix, baseURL, modulePackage string) *strings.Replacer {
129: 	var (
130: 		defaultModulePrefix = defaultPackagePrefix + modulePackage
131: 		gopagesModulePrefix = fmt.Sprintf(`<a href="%s`, path.Join(baseURL, "/pkg", modulePackage))
132: 		publicDocPrefix     = `<a href="https://pkg.go.dev/`
133: 	)
134: 	return strings.NewReplacer(
135: 		defaultModulePrefix, gopagesModulePrefix, // module links -> /base/pkg/mypkg/foo
136: 		defaultPackagePrefix, publicDocPrefix, // other package links -> https://pkg.go.dev/bar
137: 	)
138: }
